posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
You are in the right forum, I just feel like a little more description would help you a lot.
This is one of the cases where it would be good to know what you want to do with the results.
Like: is is for Main Characters that MUST have all the parts from Face over Char and Down to SV?
If you for example you could narrow it down to Char only needed it would be much more likely to get something matching. Or at least, if there is no SV needed because your game has no battles.
Also: Have you already found the modern generator freebie DLC in your steam folder?
YourHarddrive\Steam\steamapps\common\RPG Maker MV\dlc\Modern_Generator
There is something that could pass as ski goggles:
a beanie:
and various modern outfits that might pass for what you need them for
